1703:
** ἐμπαίκτης**, ου, ὁ,
**mocker, deceiver**, {{LXX+NT|LXX.Isa.3.4, NT.2Pet.3.3, NT.Jude.18.}}
1724:
** ἐνάλιος** [ᾰ], α, ον,
and ος, ον {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Andromache” 855 (nisi to be read ἐνάλου), 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Lucullus” 39}}: _Epic dialect_ and Lyric poetry also **εἰνάλιος**, α, ον ος, ον {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Helena” 526, Lyric poetry): (ἅλς B)}}:— **in, on, of the sea**, κῆτος, κορῶναι, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th c.BC: Odyssea Homerus Epicus “Odyssey” 4.443, 5.67, etc.; νομός 7th c.BC: Archilochus Lyricus 74.8}}; εἰνάλιον πόνον ἐχοίσας βαθὺν σκευᾶς ἑτέρας while the rest of the tackle is at work fishing deep **in the sea**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Pindarus Lyricus “P.” 2.79. compare 3rd c.BC: Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus 21.39; ἐ. πόροι 4th-5th c.BC: Aeschylus Tragicus “Persae” 453}}; ἐ. θεός, of Poseidon, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Oedipus Coloneus” 888 (troch.), 1493 (Lyric poetry)}}; ἐ. λεώς **sea**men, {{Refs|[prev. author] “Aj.” 565}}; πόντου εἰναλία φύσις, i.e. the fish, {{Refs|[prev. author] “Ant.” 345 (Lyric poetry)}}; of islands, ἐ. Εὐβοιὶς αἶα {{Refs|[prev. author] “fragment” 255}}; ἐ. Χθών, of Tyre, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Phoenissae” 6.}}—poetical word, used in later Prose, ἐ. νῆσοι {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “de Mundo” 392b19; δίαιται 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Lucullus” 39; ὄργανα 3rd c.AD: Porphyrius Tyrius Philosophus “de Antro Nympharum - Porphyrii Opuscula” 35.}}
1725:
** ἔναντι**,
_adverb_ **in the presence of**, with _genitive_, {{LXX+2nd c.BC+|LXX.Gen.12.19, +others, “IG” 7.2225.52 (Thisbe, 2nd c.BC), NT.Luke.1.8, “GDI” 2072.26 (Delph.)}}; compare ἴναντι.
1730:
** ἔνδειγμα**, ατος, τό,
(ἐνδείκνυμι) **evidence**, ὅτι.. {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Critias” 110b, compare 4th c.AD: Iamblichus Philosophus “de Mysteriis” 1.11}}; **token**, εὐνοίας {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Demosthenes Orator 19.256, compare 5th-6th c.AD: Damascius Philosophus “de Principiis” 46.}}
1734:
** ἑνδέκᾰτος**, η, ον,
**eleventh**, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th c.BC: Odyssea Homerus Epicus “Odyssey” 3.391, etc.}}; ἑνδεκάτη (i.e. ἡμέρη), ἡ, **eleventh day**, {{Refs|2.374.}}
1736:
** ἐνδημ-έω**,
_Doric dialect_ **ἐνδᾱμέω**, **live at** or **in** a place, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Lysias Orator 9.5, “IG” 12(5).534.6 (Ceos, 2nd c.BC)}}; simply, **stay, remain in** a place, μέχρις ἂν ἐνδημῶσιν οἱ πρέσβεις {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aeneas Tacticus 10.11}}; ἐνδημῶν καὶ ἀποδημῶν Mitteis {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|“Chr.” 284.3 (2nd c.BC)}}, etc.: _metaphorically_, ὁ θεὸς ἐνδεδήμηκεν εἰς τὴν ἐμὴν ψυχήν {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD(?): Charito Scriptor Eroticus 6.3}}; ἐ. ἐν τῷ σώματι, πρὸς τὸν Κύριον, {{NT|NT.2Cor.5.6, 8.}}
1739:
** ἐνδόμ-ησις**, εως, ἡ,
**thing built in, structure**, τοῦ τείχους {{NT|NT.Rev.21.18}}; especially **mole** or **breakwater**, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Antiquitates Judaicae” 15.9.6}}; compare ἐνδώμησις.
1740:
** ἐνδοξ-άζομαι**,
_passive_, **to be glorified**, ἔν τινι {{LXX+NT|LXX.Exo.14.4, +others, NT.2Thes.1.10, “PMag.Leid.W.” 4.17.}}
1742:
** ἔνδῡμα**, ατος, τό,
(ἐνδύω) **garment,** {{NT+5th c.BC+|Inscriptiones Graecae 12(5).593A4 (Iulis, 5th c.BC), 4th-3rd c.BC: Menander Comicus “Περικειρομένη” 269, LXX.2Ki.10.22, +others, “BCH” 6.25 (Delos, 2nd c.BC), “PFay.” 12.20 (2nd c.BC), 1st c.BC-1st c.AD: Strabo Geographus 3.3.7, NT.Matt.7.15, 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Solon” 8, 3rd c.AD: Porphyrius Tyrius Philosophus “de Abstinentia - Porphyrii Opuscula” 1.31, etc.}}; **covering**, τῶν ἀστῶν {{Refs 5th c.BC+|2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus 19.367, probably in 5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ καρδίης” 8.}}
1756:
** ἐνεργ-ής**, ές,
later form of ἐνεργός, **active, effective,** μηχανὰς ἐνεργεῖς ποιοῦντες {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Diodorus Siculus Historicus 17.44, etc.}}; of medicines, **strong,** {{Refs 1st c.AD+|POxy. 1088.56 (1st c.AD), 1st c.AD: Dioscorides (Dioscurides) Medicus 5.88, etc.: _comparative_ -έστερος}} **more effective,** πρός τινα {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Topica” 105a19}}: _superlative_ -έστατος, πρός τι {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Diodorus Siculus Historicus 1.88, compare 1st c.AD: Dioscorides (Dioscurides) Medicus 1.19, 2nd c.AD: Apollonius Dyscolus Grammaticus “de Syntaxi;” 291.9.}}
1757:
** ἐνευλογέομαι**,
_passive_, **to be blessed in,** τῷ σπέρματί σου {{LXX+NT|NT.Act.3.25, ἐν σοί LXX.Gen.12.3, NT.Gal.3.8}}:—_middle_, **take a blessing to oneself,** ἀπαρχῆς {{LXX|LXX.1Ki.2.29.}}
1766:
** ἔνᾰτος**, η, ον,
(ἐννέα) **ninth**, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th c.BC: Ilias Homerus Epicus “Illiad” 2.313, 8th-7th c.BC: Hesiodus Epicus “Opera et Dies” 772, “IG” 12.304.15, “PGrenf.” 2.24.1 (2nd c.BC), etc.}}; _Epic dialect_ εἴνατος {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th c.BC: Ilias Homerus Epicus “Illiad” 2.295, 8.266}}; _Aeolic dialect_ ἔνοτος {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|“BCH” 37.166 (Cyme, 3rd c.BC)}}; τὰ ἔνατα (i.e. ἱερά), **sacra novendialia**, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Isaeus Orator 8.39, 4th c.BC: Aeschines Orator 3.225. (Freq. written ἔννατος in codices)}}
1768:
** ἐνενήκοντα**, οἱ, αἱ, τά,
_indeclinable_, **ninety,** {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th c.BC: Ilias Homerus Epicus “Illiad” 2.602, etc.}}; compare ἐνήκοντα, ἐννήκοντα. (ἐννεν- frequently in codices, but Inscrr. have ἐνεν- {{Refs|“IG” 12.324.109, “Hermes” 17.5 (from Delos), etc.:—also _genitive_ _plural_ ἐνενηκόντων “GDI” 5653c26 (from Chios).)}}
1770:
** ἐννεύω**,
**nod** or **make signs to,** ἐννεύει με φεύγειν {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Fragmenta” 75, compare 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “DMeretr.” 12.1}}; ἐ. τινὶ τὸ τί ἂν θέλοι.. **ask** him **by signs** what.., {{NT|NT.Luke.1.62.}}
1779:
** ἐντᾰφ-ιάζω**,
**prepare for burial, lay out,** {{LXX+NT+1st c.AD+|LXX.Gen.50.2, NT.Matt.26.12, 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.995c, “Anthologia Graeca” 11.125: _metaphorically_, τὴν τυραννίδα τῇ πόλει 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Dio” 44}}:—_middle_, τὸ λοιπὸν ἐντεταφιασμένος περιπατεῖ {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Philodemus Philosophus “de Morte - Papiri Ercolanesi” 38.}}
1780:
** ἐντᾰφ-ιασμός**, ὁ,
**laying out for burial, ** NT.Mark.14.8, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|Scholia 5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Plutus” 1009, etc.}}
1785:
** ἐντολ-ή**, ἡ,
**injunction, order, command,** frequently in _plural_, **orders, commands,** {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Pindarus Lyricus “Fragmenta.” 177, 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 1.22, 3.147, 4th-5th c.BC: Aeschylus Tragicus “Prometheus Vinctus” 12, etc.; ἐντολαὶ θεοῦ NT.1Cor.7.19}}; ἐντολὰς δοῦναι Decrees cited in {{Refs 5th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Demosthenes Orator 18.75; ἐντολὴν ἐπιτελέειν 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 1.157}}; royal **ordinance,** {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|PTeb. 6.10 (2nd c.BC)}}; θεῖαι ἐ., of Imperial **ordinances**, {{Refs 3rd c.AD+|“SIG” 888.51 (3rd c.AD)}}; ἀπ᾽ ἐντολῆς by **proxy,** {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Pr.Im.” 16.}} —Rare in Trag. and _Attic dialect_ Prose.
1789:
** ἐντρέφω**,
_poetry_ **ἐνιτ-**, ={τρέφω ἐν}, **bring up** or **train in,** τέκνα {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Ion” 1428; ἐνιθρέψασ᾽ ὀροδάμνοις βότρυας “Anthologia Graeca” 9.231 (Antip.)}}:—_middle_, φυτὰ ἐνθρέψασθαι {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th-7th c.BC: Hesiodus Epicus “Opera et Dies” 781, compare 5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “Aër.” 12 (_passive_):}} —_passive_, **to be raised** or **bred in,** γυμνάσια οἷσιν ἐνετράφην {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Phoenissae” 368, compare 3rd c.BC: Callimachus Epicus “Iambi” 1.184; νόμοις 5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Leges” 798a}}; ποιήμασι, ἤθει, {{NT+1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.32e, 38b; διαλογισμοῖς 2nd c.AD: Arrianus Historicus “Epicteti Dissertationes” 4.4.48; τοῖς λόγοις τῆς πίστεως NT.1Tim.4.6.}}
1790:
** ἔντρομος**, ον,
**trembling,** {{NT+1st c.BC+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Fabius Maximus” 3, “Anthologia Graeca” 5.203 (1st c.BC: Meleager Epigrammaticus); γῆ LXX.Psa.17(18).8, NT.Act.7.32, 2nd c.AD: Soranus Medicus 1.89, “PMag.Par.” 1.3076.}}
1794:
** ἐντυλ-ίσσω**,
**wrap up,** {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Plutus” 692, “Nu.” 987 (_passive_), 5th c.BC: Diocles Comicus 13, 2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus 10.541; σῶμα σινδόνι NT.Matt.27.59.}}
1797:
** ἐνυπνι-άζω**,
**dream,** {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “de Insomniis” 459a21, “Somn.Vig.” 453b19, “HA” 537b13, +others}}:—in _middle_ and _passive_ with _accusative_, ἐνυπνιάζεσθαι θορυβώδεα {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “περὶ ἀρχαίης ἰητρικῇς” 10, compare 4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Historia Animalium” 587b10, 1st c.AD: Philo Judaeus 1.672, 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Cat.Ma.” 23}}: so in _future_ _passive_ **-ασθήσομαι**{{LXX+6th c.AD+|LXX.Joel.3.1, 6th c.AD: Lydus, Joannes Laurentius Historicus “de Ostentis” 33}}: _aorist_ _middle_ **-ασάμην**{{LXX|LXX.Josh.7.13}}_passive_ -άσθην{{LXX|LXX.Gen.37.5, 6, 10.}}
